verdict.rationale: Morph documents serving open-weight chat models through its OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints, and features Kimi K3 as a flagship migration target. That suggests it carries recent open-weight models, but nothing documents how quickly new releases are added. Missing for 10: any documented policy or track record of day-0 or fast availability of new open-weight releases, a model catalog or changelog showing release-to-availability timing, and independent corroboration.
